title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Locks — Training Notes
content:
**Rule.** A lock on a Pocketwire Visa Debit Card is a temporary, reversible freeze. The verified customer can ask for it when a card is misplaced, and the customer can also set or remove it in the app. A lock stops new purchases and ATM withdrawals. Refunds, dispute credits and incoming activity on the personal account continue. Recurring charges from merchants the card has already paid keep settling on tiers where recurring charges are allowed while locked.

A card purchase can settle only while the card's status is active or locked. On a locked card, a purchase can settle only as a recurring charge on a tier that allows it.

A lock never takes the place of a block. A card the customer knows is lost, stolen or used without their permission must be blocked instead. A blocked card can never be unlocked.

### Training questions and answers

**Q. What stops while a card is locked?**
New purchases and ATM withdrawals.

**Q. What keeps flowing to a locked card?**
Merchant refunds, dispute credits and incoming activity on the personal account. Recurring charges from merchants the card has already paid also keep settling, but only on a tier where recurring charges are allowed while locked.

**Q. A streaming subscription the card has paid before tries to renew while the card is locked. Does it settle?**
It settles on a tier where recurring charges are allowed while locked. It does not settle on a tier where they are not.

**Q. Can a purchase settle on a blocked or closed card?**
No. Settlement needs the card's status to be active or locked.

**Q. The customer says the card was stolen, but asks only for a lock. Which applies?**
A card the customer knows is stolen must be blocked, not locked. A lock is for a card that is misplaced.

**Q. Can a representative lift a lock?**
Yes. A lock is removed at the verified customer's request or by the customer in the app, and the card returns to active. A block cannot be lifted.

| Card status | New purchase or ATM withdrawal | Recurring charge from a merchant already paid |
|---|---|---|
| active | can settle | can settle |
| locked | does not settle | settles only on a tier that allows it |
| blocked or closed | does not settle | does not settle |
